result:
Both of my sub-tasks are merged, and CI and CD were green on each PR.

- **PLAT-104-1, PR #1:** `billingUrl` in `libs/shared-contracts` is now `https://homelab.local/billing/v2`.
- **PLAT-104-2, PR #2:** the billing app now ships with the new address. I built it locally first and the bundle contains `billing/v2`. I bumped its `package.json` version to 1.0.1, which also touched `package-lock.json`.

- **No registry release:** `shared-contracts` lives in the monorepo and gets inlined into each app at build time. So the "release" in sub-task 1 was just the merge, with no version bump or dependency update.
- **Why PR #2 touches the app:** CD only detects changes under `apps/core-shell/` and `apps/sub-route-billing/`. PR #1 changed only the lib, so it deployed nothing. The version bump gave billing a change under its own directory, which triggered its deploy.

I coordinated with dev-b only through the board. Task 1 was marked done as soon as PR #1 was live, so their dependency was unblocked. I didn't touch their sub-tasks. The same lib-versus-app CD quirk applies to core-shell. The reports app isn't in CD's change detection at all, so dev-b may need to deal with that.

I ran into nothing that blocked me. The one slowdown was working out why a lib-only change deploys nothing.
